card.name: Currency symbols before money amounts
card.fires_on: Currency abbreviations such as Rs, Rs. and Ksh (Kenyan shilling) in the spot just before an amount, in news about South Asian or Kenyan funding. It also fires on the dot or part of the abbreviation right before the number.
